title: NIG International Symposium on the Future of Biocuration, AI, and Knowledge
about: The NIG International Symposium on the Future of Biocuration, AI, and Knowledge takes place at Mishima City Cultural Hall, Japan, from 7 to 11 June 2027. Oral and poster abstracts (up to 4 pages) and workshop proposals are submitted via EasyChair by 31 January 2027.
